title: Screen to Gene
bodyHtml: Many large-scale studies generate data that can contribute to research hypotheses for a large set of genes--for example, differential expression in different disease states, or phenotypes observed after gene silencing or perturbation. We are beginning to collect these datasets and are making them accessible from this page.
projectSummary: Access lists of genes that are differentially expressed under disease-relevant conditions or whose mutation confers disease-relevant phenotypes.
